pluginText.pf.rules: {"contract":"A written contract for project work where the state's rules require one, signed by everyone on the deed and by the business before any money","contract_parts":"The parts the state's form lists (license number, dates, price, deposit, cancel notice, any lien notice)","cancel_window":"A cancel window after signing, where the state's rules give one; work and orders wait for it","permits":"Pulled by the license holder in the business's name, never the homeowner's","change_orders":"Written and signed by both before the changed work","final":"The engineer's or permit sign-off where needed, before the last payment","lien_waivers":"Lien waivers from the business and its subcontractors with the last payment, where the state's rules provide them","show":"The license number on the listing, the quote, the contract and the receipt, where the state's rules require it","warranty":"1 year on workmanship (the example's); the maker's warranty on piers and anchors, as the quote says; cracks may reappear, and the contract says what is covered","records":"7 years"}
pluginText.pf.edges: {"weather":"Heavy rain or frozen ground on a dig day: the work moves, with no fee; the crew lead checks the forecast the day before","engineer_plan":"The engineer's plan needs more than the quote has: a change order first, and the start may move","line_in_the_way":"A marked utility line is in the way: the crew plans around it and digs by hand near it; the start may move a day or two","hidden_conditions":"A rotted sill plate, rot or old pipe wrap found when the wall is opened: a change order before the fix; old pipe wrap that may contain asbestos stops that part of the work","moving_wall":"A wall that keeps moving, or a crack that grows during the work: the crew lead stops, tells Sam and Alex in writing, and the engineer is asked","water_in":"Water coming in during the work: the crew pumps, protects the floor and the outlets, and tells Alex","neighbor_line":"Work near a property line or a neighbor's wall: the crew lead calls Alex first; a neighbor's OK is the customer's to get","landscaping":"Plants, sod and paving moved for a dig are put back as the quote says; a larger restoration is a change order","permit_late":"The start moves with no fee; Alex is told","inspection_fails":"The crew fixes it and it's checked again; the next stage and its bill wait","cancel_after_window":"Sam and the customer settle it; Rosie moves no money on its own","nobody_home":"Estimates and small jobs with the basement reachable, with start and end photos","over_license_limit":"Not offered, and the owner is told why","walk_through_dispute":"Goes to Sam; the last bill waits","other":"All other edge cases are handled the generic way"}
